name: Fishar [Snake root, Potassium, Magnesium]
pharmacology_description: This is an effective medicine to normalize hypertension and anxiety. The main ingredient is Snake root (Rauwolfia serpentina), it acts as an ideal tranquilizer and anti-psychotic. This is very effective in insomnia, hysteria, epilepsy, violent mania, schizophrenia, severe persistent headache, tension and irritated conditions of CNS.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) twice daily or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been reported in therapeutic dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place protect from light.
